name: opencode-go-worker
description: OpenCode Go as a flat-rate worker for Claude: one-shot jobs, a code explorer and a small coding agent, with plan usage in the status line.

api_key.title: OpenCode Console API key
api_key.description: A Console key (oc_sk_...) from a workspace subscribed to Go, kept in secure storage. Leave it empty to use ~/.config/opencode-go/api_key. Environment variables are not read.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: The model new sessions use. Picking one in the model bar or with /go-model sets it.

allow_outside_workdir.title: Skip the file permission check
allow_outside_workdir.description: go_chat's files and output_path may only use paths Claude itself could Read / Write without asking, never files a deny rule blocks. Turn on to skip that check.

explore_agent.title: go_explore (code explorer)
explore_agent.description: Go answers questions about the codebase by searching and reading files on its own, and returns the answer with path:line evidence. It changes nothing.

worker_agent.title: go_agent (coding agent)
worker_agent.description: Go edits files, runs the check command Claude gives it, and fixes until it passes, all inside one call. It runs only the commands Claude lists.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin settings, model bar, status line and commands: auto (your system language), en or ko.
